params.name: chainId
params.description: Chain ID. See [here](https://docs.0x.org/docs/introduction/supported-chains) for the list of supported chains

params.name: buyToken
params.description: The contract address of the token to buy

params.name: sellToken
params.description: The contract address of the token to sell. Native token is not supported

params.name: sellAmount
params.description: The amount of `sellToken` in `sellToken` base units to sell

params.name: taker
params.description: The address which holds the `sellToken` balance and has the allowance set for the swap

params.name: recipient
params.description: The address to receive the `buyToken`. If not provided, defaults to the taker address. Not supported for wrap/unwrap operations.

params.name: swapFeeRecipient
params.description: The wallet address to receive the specified trading fees (supports single or multiple comma-separated values). You must also specify the `swapFeeBps` in the request to use this feature. When multiple values are provided, must match length of `swapFeeBps`.

params.name: swapFeeBps
params.description: The amount in Bps of the `swapFeeToken` to charge and deliver to the `swapFeeRecipient` (supports single or multiple comma-separated values). You must also specify the `swapFeeRecipient` in the request to use this feature. For security, this field has a default limit of 1000 Bps. If your application requires a higher value, please reach out to us.

params.name: swapFeeToken
params.description: The contract address of the token to receive trading fees in (supports single or multiple comma-separated values). Each token must be set to the value of either the `buyToken` or the `sellToken`. If omitted, the fee token will be determined by 0x with preference to stablecoins and highly liquid assets. You must also specify the `swapFeeRecipient` and `swapFeeBps` to charge integrator fees. When multiple values are provided, must match length of `swapFeeBps`.

params.name: tradeSurplusRecipient
params.description: The address to receive any trade surplus. If specified, this address will receive trade surplus when applicable. Otherwise, the taker will receive the surplus. This feature is only available to selected integrators on a custom pricing plan. In other cases, the surplus will be collected by 0x. For assistance with a custom plan, please contact support.

params.name: tradeSurplusMaxBps
params.description: The maximum trade surplus (positive slippage) that can be collected in Bps of the buy amount. If not provided, defaults to 10000 (100%). Must be used together with `tradeSurplusRecipient`.

params.name: slippageBps
params.description: The maximum acceptable slippage of the `buyToken` in Bps. 0x sets the optimal slippage tolerance per trade by default. To mitigate the risk of MEV attacks, we recommend adjusting this value only when trading low-liquidity tokens.

params.name: slippagePpm
params.description: The maximum acceptable slippage of the `buyToken` in parts-per-million (PPM). Mutually exclusive with `slippageBps`. e.g. 3000 PPM = 30 BPS = 0.30%.

params.name: excludedSources
params.description: Liquidity sources e.g. Uniswap_V3, SushiSwap, 0x_RFQ to exclude from the provided quote. `See https://api.0x.org/sources?chainId=<chain_id>` with the desired chain's ID for a full list of sources. Separate multiple sources with a comma
